mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_contract WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM tb_contract WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'IN_PROGRESS') ORDER BY end_date ASC
SELECT * FROM tb_contract WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND end_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '#{days} days' ORDER BY end_date ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_contract SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{contractId}
UPDATE tb_contract SET status = 'APPROVED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{contractId}
UPDATE tb_contract SET status = 'REJECTED', reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{contractId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_contract WHERE status IN ('APPROVED', 'IN_PROGRESS')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM tb_contract WHERE status IN ('APPROVED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED')

SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at) AS month, COUNT(*) AS contractCount, SUM(total_amount) AS totalAmount FROM tb_contract WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) = #{year} AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED') GROUP BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM created_at) ORDER BY month
SELECT * FROM tb_contract ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM tb_contract WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED') AND created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month

SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM tb_contract WHERE renter_id = #{renterId} AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED') AND created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month
